job.job_description:
ey Responsibilities


Design and implement enterprise-scale RAG architectures.

Develop integrations with Microsoft Graph Search, SharePoint Online, and enterprise identity platforms.

Build secure retrieval pipelines with ACL-aware and role-based access controls.

Design metadata & classification frameworks to improve retrieval relevance.

Develop document ingestion, chunking, embedding, reranking, and retrieval workflows.

Optimize answer grounding, citation generation, and response quality.

Integrate AI capabilities with workflow orchestration platforms.

Create evaluation frameworks for retrieval accuracy, security compliance, and hallucination detection.


Required Skills


Strong experience with Generative AI, RAG, Prompt Engineering, and LLMs

Hands-on expertise in Microsoft Graph API, SharePoint Online, Azure AD / Entra ID

Experience with Vector Databases (Weaviate, Azure AI Search, etc.)

Knowledge of OAuth 2.0, Access Tokens, ID Tokens, RBAC, and Security Trimming

Experience building document ingestion and search pipelines

Strong programming skills in Python, javascript and REST APIs

Thorough understanding of workflow automation tools n8n.
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG experience and transferable cloud skills, but lacks Microsoft ecosystem and n8n expertise.
